svg.title: TabPFN v3.5 - classifier
svg.desc: Prior-Labs - one multitask checkpoint; three stages: per column, per row, in context · 219.0 M parameters. Abbreviations: ICL: in-context learning: test rows attend to the labelled training rows; CLS: learned summary token that reads out a row or column; RoPE: rotary position embedding; MLP: multilayer perceptron (the feed-forward sublayer); GELU: Gaussian error linear unit (activation); LayerNorm: layer normalisation; RMSNorm: root-mean-square normalisation; QK: query and key (as in QK-norm); KV: keys and values (as in KV cache, KV heads); NaN: not-a-number: undefined values in the input; ECDF: empirical cumulative distribution function. How to read: three bands: the phases, then the stages in them, then each stage's sublayers summed over all of its stacked blocks; width: parameters, on one linear scale for the whole figure; a stage with no listed sublayers fills its own width in the sublayer band; embedding / encoder (its sublayers in a muted shade); attention (its sublayers in a muted shade); feed-forward (its sublayers in a muted shade); normalisation (its sublayers in a muted shade); decoder head (its sublayers in a muted shade); stages with no parameters (the input, a weightless embedding, the prediction) have no width and are not drawn.
